message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Casualty figures vary slightly among sources, but the generally accepted totals are:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑Belgian, Prussian)** | ~23 000 |
| **French** | ~25 000 |

These numbers include both killed and wounded, as well as soldiers taken prisoner or reported missing.  The Allied forces suffered slightly fewer casualties overall, but the French losses were still substantial, contributing to the decisive defeat of Napoleon.
